noteOps.text: DECISIONS 2026-10-29 item 83 lists every camera reader and which are right. A body reader is off whenever the camera leaves the body's eye: the roar's 1.2 s reveal (4.5 m behind, 2.2 m up), a lookbook hero pose, and every frame the follow carries shake or a verb kick (Components.jsx:1503-1505; a crit's shake puts the follow target a median 1.5 m off, item 80); the footstep surface (Components.jsx:1430) reads the camera of the frame before. Readers to move: the dragon's target, fireball aim, ground and distance (BossEntity.jsx:185,283,313-314,338,393,412,494-495); XP orbs and loot pull and collect at the camera (XPOrbSystem.jsx:22, LootSystem.jsx:41), so in the reveal a drop beside the camera is collected and one beside the body is not. The manual save already reads the body (saveSchema.js:300-309). Fix: a body place beside the view place (PositionTracker publishing both; reset-plan row 48, A21), each reader choosing, gated like mob-sense-body-gates; the view readers (streaming, the far field, the shadow centre, the weather) keep the camera, which lookbook hero shots depend on. Folds REVIEW:w2e-follow:boss-senses-camera and pickups-at-camera. Related: AUDIT:critic:camera-in-solid-class.
